meta.desc: Backend developer in Python, Flask and Django. REST APIs, georeferencing and 3D dashboards for business decisions.
hero.intro: I write Python APIs that turn scattered data into maps, routes and dashboards a sales team can use without asking for help.
mapa.aria: A route that goes from raw data to a decision, passing through an API and a dashboard
sobre.p1: I'm a software analysis and development technologist from SENA, and I specialize in backend work with Python. My job sits between two worlds: the server logic nobody sees and the visual tools the sales team actually uses.
sobre.p2: At Servimax, a family-basket goods distributor, I went from hearing a need in a meeting to delivering a working map, dashboard or API. I like sitting down with the people who will use the tool and turning what they need into something that can be built.
exp.empresa: Servimax, family-basket goods distributor. Soacha. Intern and contractor.
exp.l1: Faster routes. I built georeferencing tools on RouteVision (Flask and Leaflet.js) that automate commercial polygons and cut route-plotting time by 25%.
exp.l2: Batches of up to 50,000 records. I designed an analytics engine that processes them with per-session validation, and file collisions disappeared.
exp.l3: 3D dashboards for management. I built them with the sales team, with KPIs designed for distribution decisions. They now spot buying patterns and regional anomalies 30% faster.
exp.l4: Tidy architecture. Application Factory and Blueprints to isolate transport routes, with strict sanitization of incoming data.
p1.reto: Planning advisors' routes by hand and seeing how returns affect each area.
p1.hice: A REST API that draws interactive maps with advanced filters and CSV export, plus color-intensity and reverse-logistics modules. They improved buying-pattern detection and sped up distribution.
p2.reto: Rendering massive sales records from several affiliated brands without slowing the system down.
p2.hice: An architecture that turns complex data into optimized JSON objects and a scalable three-dimensional interface. Management spots complex trends quickly.
p3.reto: Letting the sales team read product performance from massive technical attributes.
p3.hice: An API that generates dynamic charts, filters large volumes of data and exports the findings.
p4.tec: Django, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3. SENA team project
p4.reto: Digitizing and centralizing the reporting of academic and administrative news at the center.
p4.hice: I led the backend and the database logic. I implemented the full CRUD and the permissions system, and delivered a working prototype as a team.
stack.backend: Python, Flask, Django, MySQL, SQL, REST APIs, CRUD systems with permissions
stack.frontend: HTML5, CSS3, Angular, Git, UX/UI design in Figma
edu.t1: Technologist in Software Analysis and Development
edu.t2: Technical High School Graduate in Software Development
